newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Raymond James cuts 6 bank stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Raymond James cuts 6 bank stocks.

text.p: -- Raymond James analyst Richard Bove said he downgraded six bank stocks, telling investors to take advantage of the recent rally in financial stocks to "get out at the top."
-- said stocks have been helped by talk of a budget agreement in Washington.
-- said he expects the Federal Reserve to raise its federal funds rate target to 6.5 percent by November from the current 5.5 percent.
-- "I just can't see how bank stocks can perform well in that environment," he said.
-- He cut Citicorp, Wachovia Corp and Harbor Federal Savings Bank to neutral from accumulate.
-- He lowered SunTrust Banks Inc and First Tennessee National Corp to accumulate from buy.
-- He downgraded Southwest Securities Group Inc to neutral from buy.
